facts.text: Big Mick burger -- McDowell's signature burger, stacked high on a sesame bun
facts.why: Cleo's line is that McDowell's buns have no seeds. The printed menu card already says 'No sesame seeds', so the dish note contradicts it.
facts.fix: Big Mick burger -- McDowell's signature burger, on a bun with no seeds

facts.text: Beef patties from the corner shop -- the shop next door to the barbershop in Queens
